responsibility: Declares the `Parse` class and its recursive-descent nonterminal methods, parser-local helper structures for range clauses, type switches, and captured enclosing variables, plus the token/state stacks needed for break/continue and lookahead handling. This header defines the parser’s internal organization for translating token streams into the Go frontend IR.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `Parse` class, its nonterminal method set, precedence enums, and parser-local helper/state structures such as range-clause and type-switch tracking. Unlike `parse.cc`, it is the parser’s internal interface and organization description rather than the implementation of grammar handling.
